scenarios.name: Base plan
scenarios.description: The 2027 plan as written, with the renewal tranche landing in July.

scenarios.name: Renewal lands three months late
scenarios.description: The second tranche arrives in October rather than July. The same money, later.

scenarios.name: The renewal is not awarded
scenarios.description: The bid doesn't land. Everything it was going to pay for still has to be paid for.

scenarios.name: Core funding down 40%
scenarios.description: The only money that can pay for anything, cut. Watch what stops being possible.

scenarios.name: Every funder trims 15%
scenarios.description: A sector-wide squeeze, applied evenly, which isn't how it lands.

scenarios.name: Need up 25%
scenarios.description: More people need the service. The grant doesn't grow to match.

scenarios.name: Staff turnover up half again
scenarios.description: Field roles are hard to hold at the best of times.

scenarios.name: Recruitment paused
scenarios.description: Both approved posts are held until the funding position is clear.

scenarios.name: Renewal late and need rising
scenarios.description: The money is late and more people are at the door.

interventions.name: Standardise donor reporting
interventions.description: One reporting pack, mapped to each funder's template. Three months to build, and it comes out of core, which is the money you have least of.

interventions.name: Bring the field posts forward
interventions.description: Recruit locally and shorten induction. Four months becomes two.

interventions.name: Move 5 from Monitoring into Field Delivery
interventions.description: They can do household work within a month. They aren't writing the donor reports while they do it, and the reports are a condition of the grant.

interventions.name: Defer digital case management by 4 months
interventions.description: The one thing here no funder asked for. Push it out.

interventions.name: Stop digital case management
interventions.description: Drop it and give Monitoring and Programs their people back. It was the thing that would have made next year cheaper.

interventions.name: Train half the health workers
interventions.description: Cover 60% of the cohort. The grant was awarded against the whole one.

interventions.name: Run the water points leaner and longer
interventions.description: A smaller team over a longer run. It finishes after the grant period, which is a conversation with the funder.

decisions.question: Next year is paid for by twelve people no grant will fund.
decisions.setup: The WASH renewal bid needs eight of the twelve in Fundraising, plus people from Programs and Monitoring. Every grant in the building pays for delivery. None of them pays for winning the next one, so all of that comes out of core.

options.label: Stop digital case management
options.why: It is the only thing here no funder asked for, and it is eating the same core money the bid needs.

options.label: Defer it four months
options.why: Keep it, later. Whether that helps depends on when the money is actually short.

options.label: Run the bid alongside everything else
options.why: It is five months of work and it is how the organisation exists next year.

decisions.question: The rains, and fourteen posts that land in June.
decisions.setup: Half the districts are unreachable until May and the work doesn't disappear while they are, it waits. The posts approved in February arrive in June, which is after the backlog and before the peak.

options.label: Bring the posts forward
options.why: Recruit locally and shorten induction. Four months becomes two, paid from core.

options.label: Run the water points leaner
options.why: Thirty percent fewer people over half again as long. It finishes after the grant period, which is a conversation with the funder.

options.label: Hold the plan
options.why: The team absorbs the backlog when the roads open.

decisions.question: The tranche hasn't landed.
decisions.setup: The renewal was due in July and is now expected in October. The WASH grant is spent. Field Delivery and Logistics have work, people and a funder, and for three months no money any of them is allowed to draw on.

options.label: Move five from Monitoring into the field
options.why: They can do household work within a month. They are not writing the donor reports while they do it, and those reports are a condition of the grant.

options.label: Train 60% of the cohort
options.why: Frees people and money on the health side. The grant was awarded against the whole cohort.

options.label: Carry on and reconcile later
options.why: The work continues. The accounts will show what that cost.

decisions.question: Monitoring is behind on reporting.
decisions.setup: Four funders, four templates, and reporting is a condition of every one of them. Monitoring is also carrying the renewal bid and whatever is left of the digital work.

options.label: Standardise the reporting pack
options.why: One pack mapped to every funder's template. Three months to build, out of core, which is the money you have least of.

options.label: Stop digital case management
options.why: If you have not already. It is the only work here nobody is asking you for.

options.label: Hold and catch up
options.why: The reports go in late. Funders notice.

decisions.question: October. The tranche has landed.
decisions.setup: Two and a half months of the year left, and money that can only be spent on water and the people who deliver it.

options.label: Bring the field posts forward
options.why: If you have not already. There is money for delivery now, if you have people to do it.

options.label: Move five from Monitoring into the field
options.why: If you have not already. The money is restricted to delivery, and so are they once they move.

options.label: Close the year as it stands
options.why: Spend what can be spent and hand back what cannot.

demoIntent.summary: An organisation that doesn't own its own money. Income arrives restricted, so it can be short of cash and holding cash at the same time, and the people who win next year's funding are the only ones no funder will pay for.
intents: Restricted money cannot move to where the shortfall is, so unfunded cost and stranded funds rise together.
Bid writing is the only work that secures next year and the only work with no grant behind it.
A tranche arriving three months late is the same money and a materially worse year.

routes.name: Visits that raise a supply request
